'''Sector 18''' was an area of land that was regularly patrolled by [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex squadron]].

==History==
During the [[Ardan resistance|Rebel]] occupation of [[Arda I]], a [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Probe droid]] was sent to sector 18 and revealed the position of [[Arda Base]].
